text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Yeah, you got rejected. ...Come on, 
don't cry. You found the courage to 
confess your feelings, and that's 
something to be proud of."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, why don't we all have a girls' 
night tonight? ...Yeah, I'll be waiting. 
See you♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright then! Better hurry. I've gotta 
bake that pie she loves so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And besides, I have to invite lots of 
friends too. ...Hehe, just you wait. I'll 
throw you a party to remember.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Tears don't suit that girl at all!
